task: Draft a 100–150-word workplace-news brief from a fictional cooperative's trial memo and two supplied statements. Make clear what has been approved, what remains unknown, and what each speaker is discussing. Do not invent trial results, pay changes, or an opposing voice beyond the actual source packet.

facts.text: Inkling Print Collective has approved a six-week trial of a four-day rota for its bindery team.
The team's scheduled weekly hours remain 32 during the trial.
The trial's start date has not been announced.
The manager's exact statement is: "We're testing the rota, not announcing a permanent change."
The staff delegate's exact statement is: "A shorter week must not mean longer queues for help."
The memo says the review will consider whether support coverage is maintained.
The packet contains no trial outcomes or information about changes to pay.

forbidden_additions: A permanent four-day policy, reduced weekly hours, or an invented pay change.
Productivity gains, staff satisfaction results, or completed trial findings.
An invented start date, interview, or additional stakeholder position.
preserve: Four working days distinguished from a reduction in the supplied 32 weekly hours.
The different but source-supported emphases of the manager and staff delegate.
A future review criterion rather than an already demonstrated benefit.
